instruct: Castilian Spanish accent from Spain (c and z pronounced as 'th'), natural and human, never robotic. Male narrator in his thirties, conversational and witty, like telling a story to a friend, natural rhythm, slight smile in the voice, medium pitch.

lineas.texto: Imagina que esta noche te duermes… y te despiertas en el año mil trescientos.
Sin móvil. Sin luz. Y con un gallo gritándote en la oreja antes de que salga el sol.
